 Order
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 439 Cr.P.C. seeking regular bail in FIR No. 149/2019 dated 14.09.2019 under Sections 376/506 IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012 at PS Chandani Mahal, Delhi.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
She seeks, and is granted, four weeks to file the Status Report alongwith MLC and/or PMR, if needed.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/12/2023 at 01:11:18 6.
Let the Nominal Roll be also requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendant within four weeks.

7. Since this is a matter inter alia Section 376 IPC, let intimation under Section 439(1-A) Cr.P.C read with Delhi High Court Practice Directions dated 24.09.2019 in form Annexure-A attached to the Practice Directions be sent by the Investigating Officer to the complainant/ prosecutrix/ informant informing them of the pendency of the present matter to enable them or their authorised signatory to be present in Court if they so desire, either through video conferencing or in Court.

It is clarified Akram vs State & Anr on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191946689/
1 that it is not compulsory for the prosecutrix to appear in person for the hearing.

8. List on 08.02.2024.
